unscannable_companies.name: Namogoo
unscannable_companies.reason: The real careers page (namogoo.com/careers) is behind an active bot-protection JS challenge (Cloudflare Turnstile served via abtasty.com) — Playwright's real browser never reaches actual page content, it lands on a 'Just a moment...' challenge page instead. Not a robots.txt block; this is the page itself refusing automated access outright.

unscannable_companies.name: BlazeMeter
unscannable_companies.reason: This project's httpx client receives HTTP 403 from the site's own WAF on a plain GET of robots.txt itself, which — per ComplianceAgent's documented 401/403-on-robots.txt handling (mirrors urllib.robotparser's own semantics) — resolves to disallow-everything. Confirmed non-transient and client-specific: curl and a real Playwright browser both get a normal 200 with no disallow rules for /careers at all, at the same moment httpx gets 403 — a WAF fingerprinting this project's plain-httpx client specifically, not a genuine robots.txt restriction or a real platform-support gap.

unscannable_companies.name: Centrical
unscannable_companies.reason: Same confirmed finding as BlazeMeter above: this project's httpx client gets HTTP 403 on robots.txt itself (resolving to disallow-everything per ComplianceAgent's policy), while curl and Playwright's real browser are not blocked.

unscannable_companies.name: ForSight Robotics
unscannable_companies.reason: Real, confirmed Israeli medtech company ($125M Series B) with a genuinely custom career page (forsightrobotics.com/careers) — real, structured open positions ARE published (e.g. 'R&D Mechanical Engineer, Israel, Caesarea, Full time') but rendered as plain Webflow CMS-collection HTML elements (.c-list_list-item, grouped by department via a small inline JS helper), not the JSON-in-a-script-tag pattern CustomAdapter currently knows how to parse (adapters/custom.py's own documented limit — a genuinely different rendering pattern needs a second extraction strategy, not just a new config entry). Real data exists; this project's tooling can't extract it yet.
